headerDisplay: Control DIHOOL IPS-S2 scissor lifts via the eWeLink LAN protocol. Enter your eWeLink credentials for automatic device discovery, or configure devices manually with their Device ID and LAN Key.

username.title: eWeLink Email or Phone
username.description: Your eWeLink account email or phone number. Required for automatic device discovery.

countryCode.title: Country Code
countryCode.description: Your country calling code (e.g. +1 for US, +44 for UK).

mode.title: Connection Mode
mode.description: In 'auto' mode, the plugin logs into eWeLink to discover devices, then controls them over LAN. In 'lan' mode, no cloud connection is made and each device entry must include a Device ID and LAN Key.

liftSenseCallbackPort.title: LiftSense Callback Port
liftSenseCallbackPort.description: Local port that receives authenticated motor-state callbacks from LiftSense.

liftSenseCallbackHost.title: LiftSense Callback Host
liftSenseCallbackHost.description: Hostname or reserved LAN IPv4 address that LiftSense can use to reach this Homebridge server. Leave blank to disable callbacks and use polling only.

devices.title: Lift Devices
devices.description: Per-device configuration. Every entry requires a Device ID so settings stay attached to the correct lift. Manual/LAN-only devices also require a LAN Key. With cloud discovery, devices are found automatically; use this section for per-device overrides.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: The eWeLink device ID (e.g. 100293a98d). Every lift entry must have this value so its settings stay attached to the correct lift. Found in the eWeLink app under device settings, or in the Homebridge log on startup.

label.title: Display Name
label.description: Custom name for this lift in HomeKit.

lanKey.title: LAN Key
lanKey.description: Device encryption key. Required for manual/LAN-only devices. Cloud-discovered devices get this automatically. Use the get-lankey script to obtain this.

ipAddress.title: IP Address Override
ipAddress.description: Manual IP address. Only needed if mDNS discovery doesn't find the device.

upChannel.title: Up Channel
upChannel.description: eWeLink outlet index for the UP motor control. Default: 0.

downChannel.title: Down Channel
downChannel.description: eWeLink outlet index for the DOWN motor control. Default: 1.

manualSwitches.title: Manual Override Switches
manualSwitches.description: Expose Manual Up and Manual Down switches that send raw motor pulses, bypassing state tracking. Useful for recovering from state mismatches or manual control.

esp32Host.title: LiftSense ESP32 Hostname
esp32Host.description: mDNS hostname or IP address of the LiftSense ESP32. Leave blank to disable sensor polling.

esp32Token.title: LiftSense ESP32 API Token
esp32Token.description: The shared API token configured in the ESP32 firmware.

esp32PollIntervalSec.title: ESP32 Poll Interval (seconds)
esp32PollIntervalSec.description: How often to read the ESP32 sensor status.

esp32DebugLogging.title: ESP32 Debug Logging
esp32DebugLogging.description: Log every ESP32 distance reading and calculated position. Useful while calibrating; leave off during normal use.

esp32SyncTargetPosition.title: Show Measured Percentage in Home
esp32SyncTargetPosition.description: Synchronize HomeKit's target display with the measured percentage. Keep disabled until the ESP32 sensor is installed and calibrated. This changes HomeKit display state only and never sends a lift command.

invertMotorChannelDirections.title: Invert Motor Channel Directions
invertMotorChannelDirections.description: Swap the observed motor directions reported by LiftSense. By default motor detector channel 1 means up and channel 2 means down. This affects HomeKit movement display only and never changes the DIHOOL control channels.

minDistanceMm.title: Minimum Distance (mm)
minDistanceMm.description: Minimum sensor reading, measured with the lift fully raised. This maps to 100%.

maxDistanceMm.title: Maximum Distance (mm)
maxDistanceMm.description: Maximum sensor reading, measured with the lift fully lowered. This maps to 0%.

layout.title: eWeLink Account
layout.description: Enter your eWeLink credentials for automatic device discovery.

items.title: Network & Channels
items.description: Only change these if you know what you're doing.

items.title: LiftSense Sensor
items.description: Configure the optional LiftSense ESP32 distance sensor and its calibration.
